rows.en: Here is our new flat.
We have been living here a year now.
I often work at home.

rows.ru: Друг увидел квартиру и сказал, что она большая.
rows.en: A friend saw the flat and said it was big.
Even he wants to live here.
My wife and I were at home.
We have a dog.
The dog has a big head.

rows.ru: Она весь день стояла у двери.
rows.en: She stood by the door all day.

rows.ru: Жена сказала, что это её дело.
rows.en: My wife said that was her business.
Yesterday I worked for two hours.

rows.ru: Без тебя я ничего не делаю.
rows.en: Without you I get nothing done.
The work was going really well.

rows.ru: А ты можешь работать два часа?
rows.en: And can you work for two hours?
Never mind, everyone works the way they like.
There was wine on the table.
My father knows how to make it.

rows.ru: Мы пили вино и говорили об истории семьи.
rows.en: We drank wine and talked about our family history.
And afterwards there was music.
It is always so good at home.
This is my favourite book.
Not everyone knows it.
I read it every year.

rows.ru: Это моя задача на весь день.
rows.en: That is my task for the whole day.
A favourite book is like a friend.
My friend works at a factory.
They pay well there.
He earns money for his family.

rows.ru: Его коллеги говорят, что он богатый.
rows.en: His colleagues say he is rich.

rows.ru: Но товары в городе очень дорогие.
rows.en: But things in town are very expensive.

rows.ru: Сегодня у нас встреча с директором.
rows.en: Today we have a meeting with the director.
The director gave us a new assignment.
All the employees were at the meeting.

rows.ru: Он сказал, что зарплата будет в долларах.
rows.en: He said the salary would be in dollars.
After the meeting everyone went off to work.

work:2.title: The worker who was not paid

rows.ru: Этот рабочий уже два года на заводе.
rows.en: This worker has been at the factory for two years.
Yesterday they did not pay him.
His family is living without money.
The director said the money would come.

rows.ru: Но рабочий уже думает о новой службе.
rows.en: But the worker is already thinking about a new job.
Today all the employees will get their pay.
We are standing by the cash desk.

rows.ru: Наш руководитель говорит с каждым работником.
rows.en: Our manager speaks with every employee.

rows.ru: Начальник сказал, что зарплата будет больше.
rows.en: The boss said the pay would be higher.

rows.ru: После этого я иду покупать книги.
rows.en: After that I go and buy books.
We have a meeting today.
The whole team is already here.

rows.ru: Наш инженер проработал на заводе два года.
rows.en: Our engineer put in two years at the factory.
The administrator gave everyone a new assignment.

rows.ru: Инженер говорит, что этот товар дешёвый.
rows.en: The engineer says this product is cheap.

rows.ru: На собрании говорили о новой профессии.
rows.en: At the meeting they talked about a new profession.

rows.ru: Менеджер сказал, что это денежная профессия.
rows.en: The manager said it is a well-paid profession.

rows.ru: Все в компании трудятся каждый день.
rows.en: Everyone at the company works hard every day.

rows.ru: Моя профессия не самая денежная, но любимая.
rows.en: Mine is not the best paid profession, but I love it.
At home my wife said: you work too hard.
Every day I feed the cat.

rows.ru: Наш кот всегда бегает по квартире.
rows.en: Our tomcat is always running about the flat.
There is a bird living in the cage.
The bird has to be fed too.
But we do not have a cow.
There was a mouse in the flat.

rows.ru: Кот бегал за ней весь день.
rows.en: The cat chased it all day.
Mum does not want to see mice.

rows.ru: Мышь — не насекомое, но мама её не любит.
rows.en: A mouse is not an insect, but Mum does not like it.
A butterfly, though, she likes.

rows.ru: В книге я увидел лошадь и медведя.
rows.en: In the book I saw a horse and a bear.
A horse was standing by a door.
A goat and a hen were at home.

rows.ru: У птицы большие крылья, а у кота лапы.
rows.en: A bird has big wings, and a cat has paws.

rows.ru: Эту книгу я читаю каждый день.
rows.en: I read this book every day.
A bird has built a nest by the door.
Our little mouse lives under the table.
The cat went over to the nest.
The pig, meanwhile, saw nothing.

rows.ru: Каждое животное здесь имеет своё место.
rows.en: Every animal here has its own place.
